pre_outcome_source_amendment: Transaction probe before any return replay showed the first sample volume includes the opening auction. Exclude index 0 from target exit fills; use minute-end labels throughout.
post_replay_market_rule_correction: Enforce STAR minimum 200 shares instead of allowing 100; maintain 100-share sizing increments (valid above the 200 minimum). No main-board or grid changes. Original v2 selection R0381 and results archived before correction; assert all main-board selected performance unchanged after replay.
scope: Current mootdx Shanghai/Shenzhen A-share universe; exclude unverified 5pct candidates
calendar: PostgreSQL mootdx observed market sessions; D2/D3 never skip stock suspensions

execution.minute_clock: 240 samples mapped to bucket ends 09:31..11:30,13:01..15:00; price samples, not OHLC. Index 1 is the 09:31 transaction bucket ending 09:32. Index 0 volume includes opening auction.
execution.signal_order: Observe sample t; fill no earlier than sample t+1. Cancel on any observed breach before fill; no fill at upper limit or insufficient volume. First fill only per entry rule.

entry_modes.breakout: Signal from 09:32 when price exceeds both opening and 09:31 price by at least one tick
entry_modes.reclaim: After a sampled dip below opening, signal on subsequent reclaim of opening by one tick

exits.open_benchmark: D3 daily open, cost/slippage deducted; reference only, no auction fill assurance
exits.early: Observe 09:31, submit sell; first eligible sample from 09:32 through 14:57 above lower limit, with sufficient volume
exits.target: Before D3 continuous trading, submit limit sell at smallest cent price yielding at least 5.1% net after model costs; require sample at least one cent above slippage-adjusted target and sufficient volume. Only samples ending 09:32 onward qualify; exclude index 0 auction-mixed volume. If not filled through 14:54, submit marketable sell at 14:55 and use first eligible 14:56..14:57 sample. Unfilled D3 counted as target failure.

execution.daily_high: Hindsight upper boundary only; never used to determine executable success
execution.unknown_data: Report separately; include unknown D3 outcomes in conservative denominator after a valid buy
execution.corporate_actions: Any D2/D3 price/share-changing action: return unscorable without entitlement accounting; never discard from conservative buy denominator
execution.capacity: Independent 10000 CNY hypothetical orders; not a funded portfolio or personal queue proof

selection.split_by: D2 entry date; purge events whose D3 crosses a split boundary
selection.shortlist: Top 10 training rules by Wilson 95% lower bound, then mean known return, then rule id
selection.final_choice: Among training shortlist passing validation sample minimum, highest validation Wilson lower bound, then training Wilson lower bound, then rule id; freeze before holdout evaluation
selection.no_eligible_rule: Report no qualified rule; show best training rule only as exploratory
selection.inference: Wilson intervals plus entry-date cluster bootstrap, fixed seed 20261002, 2000 resamples; descriptive, not multiple-testing-adjusted proof
selection.previous_research_overlap: This project previously inspected part of 2026; September is only a holdout from this run, not a pristine future test
selection.deployment: Research only, no auto orders, no strategy activation

known_limitations: No historical order book or queue IDs; executable-price/volume proxy cannot establish individual order success
Historical names/ST changes unavailable; current universe creates survivorship bias
Industry uses current classification, not historical theme membership or point-in-time news
Market caps/turnover can depend on estimated share counts; 5d return is unadjusted
Daily capital and minute units must be cross-checked; failures are flagged rather than filled
No promise of future 80% probability; retrospective winners are not prospective selectors
